scripts.sandbox:delete: npx ampx sandbox delete --identifier sandbox --profile sake-db --yes
scripts.sandbox:reset: npm run sandbox:delete && npm run sandbox
scripts.prepush:check:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; if git rev-parse --verify @{upstream} >/dev/null 2>&1; then FILES=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR @{upstream}...HEAD); else DEFAULT_BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref --quiet refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); DEFAULT_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH#refs/remotes/}; if [ -n "$DEFAULT_BRANCH" ]; then FILES=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR "$DEFAULT_BRANCH"...HEAD); else FILES=$(git diff-tree --root --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD); fi; fi; if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then exit 0; fi; FORMAT_FILES=$(printf "%s
" "$FILES" | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|mts|json|css|md)$" || true); if [ -n "$FORMAT_FILES" ]; then printf "%s
" "$FORMAT_FILES" | xargs -r npx prettier --write; if ! printf "%s
" "$FORMAT_FILES" | xargs git diff --quiet --; then echo "pre-push hook formatted files. Commit the changes and push again."; exit 1; fi; fi; LINT_FILES=$(printf "%s
" "$FILES" | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" || true); if [ -n "$LINT_FILES" ]; then printf "%s
" "$LINT_FILES" | xargs -r npx eslint --max-warnings=0; fi'
